q: The Kantorovich dual of the optimal transport problem with cost c(x,y) is:
exp: Kantorovich dual: max over (φ,ψ) with φ(x)+ψ(y) ≤ c(x,y) of ∫φdμ + ∫ψdν. For c(x,y) = |x−y|, ψ = −φ and ||φ||_{Lip} ≤ 1, recovering the Wasserstein-1 = Kantorovich-Rubinstein formula: W₁(μ,ν) = max_{||f||_{Lip}≤1} |∫fdμ − ∫fdν|.
